title: Normalize Vcs Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize the vcs plugin crate (vcs/plugin/rs/lib.rs) to the framework Consistency Contract: adopt PanelKit tree helpers (tree_item_with_action, PanelTreeBuilder, selection_ids) in build_document_tree; adopt Terminology (app_labels! macro, resolve_labels, is_de_locale, localized_label_map, AppLabelsOverlayExt) replacing the hand-rolled VcsLabels struct/consts/resolver and manual AppLabelsOverlay struct literal; adopt Testkit (semio_framework_plugin::testkit::meta/new_app) replacing local meta()/new_app() test scaffolding; verify C1 naming (app struct = VcsPlayApp for app id vcs-play, already compliant); fix region markers/order to canonical Constants->Types->DocumentHelpers->Terminology->CommandLabels->Panels->Render->App impl->Manifest->Tests, renaming Domain->Types/DocumentHelpers split and AppFactory->Manifest. Single-app crate stays flat (no app_<name> mod wrapping). Do not touch the GraphTimeline surface/scene definitions (framework-owned).
summary:
Normalized vcs/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the Consistency Contract. Adopted framework PanelKit (tree_item_with_action + PanelTreeBuilder + selection_ids) for build_document_tree, replacing the hand-rolled UiTreeItemNode/UiTreeSectionNode/UiTreeNode literals and the inline ids-array parsing in the setSelection handler; this also fixed a latent compile bug where the manual UiTreeSectionNode literals omitted the (now-required) `loading` field. Adopted framework Terminology (app_labels! macro, resolve_labels, is_de_locale, localized_label_map, AppLabelsOverlayExt fluent builder) replacing the hand-rolled VcsLabels struct/EN-DE consts/resolver fn and the manual AppLabelsOverlay struct-literal in app_labels(), which also fixed a second latent compile bug (bare unimported `HashMap::new()` calls for the always-empty overlay fields). Adopted framework Testkit (testkit::meta/testkit::new_app) in place of the crate-local meta()/new_app() functions across all test call sites; no paired_apps/new_app_with_registry/MemoryBackbone::pair usage existed in this crate so nothing to replace there, and the one undo/redo test that also asserts on emitted "history-changed" events was left as its own hand-rolled body (outside the 3 generic testkit shapes) per instructions. Verified C1 (app struct VcsPlayApp already matches PascalCase(vcs-play)+App, no rename needed), C4 (single-app crate stays flat, no app_<name> mod wrapping applied), C6 (Cargo.toml only depends on vcs + semio-framework-plugin, no cross-app deps) - all already compliant, no changes needed. Renamed region 🔖️AppFactory -> 🔖️Manifest, split 🔖️Domain into 🔖️Types (structs/enums + Operation/OperationDiff impls) and 🔖️DocumentHelpers (free functions incl. seed_vcs_demo_history), and reordered regions into the canonical Constants -> Types -> DocumentHelpers -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Panels -> Render -> VcsPlayApp -> Manifest -> Tests sequence (moved CommandLabels from after the App impl to before Panels). Did not touch the GraphTimeline surface/scene definitions (framework-owned) - render_history's call to build_graph_timeline_scene is untouched. No other files under vcs/** needed changes (core/js, rs/pkg are unrelated Vcs domain crate/JS wrapper, not the plugin app).

VERIFICATION: ran a full identifier/region cross-reference (grep for stale VcsHistoryApp/AppFactory/Domain/vcs_labels/VCS_LABELS_NATIVE_*, region-tag pair matcher script confirming all 10 //#region/#endregion pairs match names and are in canonical order, brace/paren balance check: 273/273 and 770/770). Ran `rustfmt --check` with the repo's rustfmt.toml; it reported diffs but they are pre-existing and appear uniformly throughout code I did not touch (e.g. inside the untouched seed_vcs_demo_history body), so they reflect a rustfmt-version/formatting drift predating this change, not something introduced by this pass - all diff hunks I inspected in my touched regions matched the file's existing style. Attempted `cargo check -p vcs-plugin` but it sat blocked (no output) for 4+ minutes behind the shared build lock - confirmed via `ps aux` that 6+ other concurrent cargo check processes for other crates (mathematical-plugin, sequence-plugin, sourcing-plugin, raster-plugin, infinite_board, and another vcs check) were contending for the same lock, consistent with the documented repo-wide contention; per verification policy I did not block further and left it running in the background rather than confirm a compile. Did not run the test suite for the same reason. The orchestrator's final full `cargo check --workspace` + test sweep is the authoritative gate for this crate's actual compilation.

NOTHING TO FLAG for Wave 4: every mechanism this crate needed (PanelKit tree builder, Terminology macro/resolver/overlay builder, Testkit meta/new_app) had a clean, real SDK primitive to move onto - no missing/awkward-fit SDK surface encountered.
